title: A partial class declared in two files
pins: One type, two declarations, one identity per file, so the edit set would cover a single part and split the type: part-a would declare Renamed while part-b still declares Counter, splitting one class into two that both still compile. The engine refuses with SplitDeclaration. Until 0.30 this case was a module declared in two files; a 0.30 module header only labels its compilation unit, so two files with one label are two units, not one split declaration, and a partial type is the remaining declaration that spans files. Lifting this refusal is #922.
